2608.03999.title: Agogic: Performance-Timed Music Tokens for LLM-Native Text-to-Symbolic-Music Generation
2608.03999.paper_summary: Text-to-music language models begin with a choice usually made by default: how to tokenize music. Normally entangled with backbone, data, and recipe, its effect has never been measured in isolation. We fix pretrained Qwen3.5 (0.8B-27B), data, budget, and decoding, and swap only the representation across seven tokenizations, anchoring texture metrics to each representation's model-free ceiling. The ordering is clean and surprising: representation, not model size, is the binding variable for distributional fidelity. Scaling the backbone 34x barely moves Frechet Music Distance (FMD), whereas switching representation halves it. PMT, a performance-resolution stream we release (10 ms timing, per-note velocity, multi-track texture; 609 symbols), reaches FMD 159 at 0.8B against 272-286 for beat grids (1.7-1.8x lower, up to 2.8x elsewhere; non-overlapping bootstrap CIs), so a 0.8B performance-resolution model beats a 27B beat grid. It reappears on a 26M from-scratch backbone and a second performance-resolution tokenizer: a property of the class, not one lucky vocabulary. Nor is it a finer-lattice artifact: snapping PMT's onsets to the beat grids' resolution still leaves it 67-129 FMD ahead of both (n=500). The effect is distributional; whether it is audible is a separate question, left open by our probe, with a human study pre-registered. Native caption adherence is weak but separable: a lightweight decode-time constraint doubles instrument-F1 (.28 to .60) and Correct-Key (.16 to .35) at no distributional cost. We release the harness, 25+ checkpoints, two corpora (86.6k aligned across caption/MIDI/ABC/audio; 6.25M captioned, the largest for music), and an imprinting diagnostic: published text-to-MIDI systems reproduce their training distribution near-invariant to the caption (72% vs. 71% chord-time on disjoint domains). The field's next representation claim can now be measured, not asserted.
2608.03999.paper_summary_zh: 文本到音樂的語言模型通常從一個預設的選擇開始：如何對音樂進行標記。這通常與骨幹、數據和配方糾纏在一起，其影響從未單獨測量過。我們固定預訓練的 Qwen3.5 (0.8B-27B)、數據、預算和解碼，僅在七種標記法之間交換表示，將質感指標錨定到每個表示的無模型上限。排序清晰且令人驚訝：表示，而非模型大小，是分佈忠實度的綁定變數。將骨幹擴展 34 倍幾乎不會影響 Frechet 音樂距離 (FMD)，而切換表示則將其減半。我們發布的 PMT，一個性能-解析度流（10 毫秒時間，每音符速度，多軌質感；609 符號），在 0.8B 下達到 FMD 159，而節拍網格為 272-286（低 1.7-1.8 倍，在其他地方可達 2.8 倍；不重疊的自助置信區間），因此 0.8B 的性能-解析度模型優於 27B 的節拍網格。它在一個 26M 的從零開始的骨幹和第二個性能-解析度標記器上重新出現：這是該類別的特性，而不是某個幸運的詞彙。這也不是一個更細的格子工件：將 PMT 的起始音符對齊到節拍網格的解析度仍然使其在 FMD 上領先於兩者 67-129（n=500）。這一效果是分佈性的；它是否可聽見是一個單獨的問題，我們的探測留下了開放的空間，並已預註冊了一項人類研究。原生標題遵循性較弱但可分離：輕量級的解碼時間約束使樂器-F1（從 .28 增加到 .60）和正確音調（從 .16 增加到 .35）翻倍，且沒有分佈成本。我們發布了這個工具，25+ 個檢查點，兩個語料庫（86.6k 在標題/MIDI/ABC/音頻上對齊；6.25M 帶標題，為音樂中最大的），以及一個印記診斷：已發布的文本到 MIDI 系統在訓練分佈中幾乎不變地重現其標題（在不相交領域上的和弦時間為 72% 對 71%）。該領域的下一個表示聲明現在可以被測量，而不是僅僅聲稱。
